name: cache admission — may this caller read this entry?
notes: Nine situations, two answers -- so the decision itself needs only one bit.
That is NOT the same as saying the system needs one bit: to COMPUTE the answer it must
retain the owner, which is a 3-way distinction per entry. The floor is a bound on the
state needed to produce the declared ANSWER, and choosing the answer function carelessly
is the easiest way to compute a floor that is true and useless.
